from io import BytesIO
import zipfile

import pytest

from ansible.errors import AnsibleError
from ansible.executor import module_common as mc


def test_collection_redirect_and_package_imports(mocker):
    prefix = 'ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.module_utils'
    sources = {
        'plugins/module_utils/pkg/__init__.py': b'from .submod import X\\nfrom ..cousin.submod import Y\\n',
        'plugins/module_utils/pkg/submod.py': b'X = 1\\n',
        'plugins/module_utils/cousin/submod.py': b'Y = 2\\n',
        'plugins/module_utils/target.py': b'VALUE = 3\\n',
    }
    metadata = {'plugin_routing': {'module_utils': {'alias': {'redirect': 'ns.coll.target'}}}}
    mocker.patch.object(mc, '_get_collection_metadata', return_value=metadata)
    mocker.patch.object(mc.pkgutil, 'get_data', side_effect=lambda package, path: sources.get(path))
    names = {('ansible', '__init__'), ('ansible', 'module_utils', '__init__')}
    cache = {}
    output = BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(output, 'w') as zf:
        mc.recursive_finder('demo', 'ansible.modules.demo',
                            ('import %s.pkg\\nimport %s.alias\\nimport %s.cousin.submod\\n' %
                             (prefix, prefix, prefix)).encode(), names, cache, zf)
        files = set(zf.namelist())
        assert 'ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins/module_utils/pkg/__init__.py' in files
        assert 'ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins/module_utils/pkg/submod.py' in files
        assert 'ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins/module_utils/cousin/submod.py' in files
        assert 'ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins/module_utils/cousin/__init__.py' in files
        assert 'ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins/module_utils/alias.py' in files
        assert 'ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins/module_utils/target.py' in files
        assert zf.read('ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins/module_utils/cousin/__init__.py') == b''
        assert b'ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.module_utils.target' in zf.read('ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins/module_utils/alias.py')


def test_missing_collection_error(mocker):
    mocker.patch.object(mc, '_get_collection_metadata', side_effect=ValueError('unable to locate collection absent.coll'))
    with pytest.raises(AnsibleError, match='unable to locate collection absent.coll'):
        mc.CollectionModuleUtilLocator(('ansible_collections', 'absent', 'coll', 'plugins', 'module_utils', 'foo'))


def test_ambiguity_only_below_module_utils(mocker):
    mocker.patch.object(mc, '_get_collection_metadata', return_value={})
    mocker.patch.object(mc.pkgutil, 'get_data', return_value=None)
    root = ('ansible_collections', 'ns', 'coll', 'plugins', 'module_utils')
    assert mc.CollectionModuleUtilLocator(root + ('foo',), True).candidate_names_joined() == ['.'.join(root + ('foo',))]
    assert len(mc.CollectionModuleUtilLocator(root + ('foo', 'symbol'), True).candidate_names_joined()) == 2
EOF
PYTHONPATH=lib python -m pytest -q test/units/executor/module_common/test_collection_locator.py test/units/executor/module_common/test_recursive_finder.py"
